findings.detail: The opening status says the next structural round is Critical-only and cites 23 tests and ten guard plants. Later sections record that structural round as completed, report 28 tests, and identify focused Important review as next. A maintainer resuming from the synopsis receives obsolete review instructions.
findings.fix: Replace the outdated synopsis with: “Structural review ended clean at Critical. Focused Nit fixes and input-kind preflight are implemented. The latest recorded focused Scrut run passed 28 unittest checks. Next is focused Important review; full-suite and publication gates remain pending.” Preserve the historical sections below.
findings.title: Uncited: The ledger’s opening status contradicts its latest recorded state.

strengths: The reference clearly distinguishes private-copy isolation from sandboxing and states script trust requirements.
The unittest example uses precise success markers and explicit skip/error exclusions.
The capture documentation accurately explains output limits, deadlines and escaped-descendant responsibilities.
summary: Reviewed all 32 membership paths and cross-checked changed comments and documentation against the implementation. Found one stale status synopsis and no Important or Critical comment defects: clean at Important. Review remained read-only; tests were unrun and GitHub metadata verification was unavailable.
